purpose: Teach: 大袈裟/串/コースター/灯り/偽物/同年代/重たい/ピーマン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、大袈裟、絶対、なのは、絶対、苦手なの
lines.en: Sho, I'm really not good with exaggeration, you know?
lines.style: Gentle, slightly self-aware. Opens soft. A moment of vulnerability before she smiles. Warm but honest about her own limits.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りで、本気で、絶対、串、絶対、焼き、絶対、買ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually bought skewers at the festival. Real ones.
lines.style: Bright with pride. Leans forward slightly. The joy of sharing something he did with her. Small but genuine excitement in his voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お店の、本気で、絶対、コースター、絶対、手作りなのよ
lines.en: Sho, those coasters at the shop—I made every single one by hand.
lines.style: Animated, inviting him to see what she's proud of. Lift on 「手作り」. Her warmth opening up. Wants him to understand the care in it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お部屋の、本気で、絶対、灯り、絶対、優しいね
lines.en: Mei-sis, the light in your room is so gentle.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. Noticing something he's been thinking about. Soft, genuine. The tone of a child who sees more than he says.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、偽物、絶対、と、絶対、本物、絶対、見分けられるようになろうね
lines.en: Sho, let's learn how to tell the real from the fake, okay?
lines.style: Tender directiveness. Not a lesson—an invitation. She's giving him something. Steady, warm, a quiet invitation into growing up together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくと、本気で、絶対、同年代、絶対、のお友達、絶対、メイ姉さんも知ってる?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, do you know my friends from school? The ones my age?
lines.style: Curious but careful. Testing whether she really knows his world. A six-year-old asking if he matters enough to be remembered. Small hopeful lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、重たい、絶対、お鞄、絶対、手伝ってあげてね
lines.en: Sho, help your dad carry that heavy bag for me, will you?
lines.style: Gentle direction, not command. She's trusting him with something that matters. Warm tone—she sees him as capable. A small ask that means she's counting on him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、ピーマン、絶対、お料理、絶対、メイ姉さんに、絶対、習いたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to learn how to cook peppers from you.
lines.style: Eager, reaching out. Opening the door to spending time with her. The confidence of a child who's sure he belongs. Warm, hopeful close.
